title: Integrations
subtitle: Slack, webhooks, email, and more — wire how SolidPing reaches you.
newSubtitle: Pick the integration type to configure.
editSubtitle: Secret values are stored encrypted; updating them replaces the stored value.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this integration?
deleteConfirm.body: Bound checks lose this notification target. The action cannot be undone.

empty.title: No integrations yet
empty.body: Add an integration to start receiving notifications. Pick one to get going:

form.name: Name
form.defaultHelp: Pre-checked when creating a new check. Existing checks are unaffected.
form.slackOauthHint: Slack channels are configured via the Slack OAuth install. The bot will populate workspace and channel names on completion.
form.slackNotConnectedBody: This channel has no linked Slack workspace. Install the SolidPing Slack app to connect one.
form.testHelp: Deliver a sample alert to confirm this integration is wired up. The test uses the saved settings.
form.testNeedsSave: Save your changes first — the test uses the saved settings.

freebox.name: Freebox
freebox.description: Monitor your Freebox line quality and network status
freebox.baseUrlHint: Leave as-is if SolidPing runs on the same LAN as the Freebox. For remote access, use the public hostname you configured in the Freebox admin under Settings → Freebox OS API.
freebox.deviceNameHint: Shown on the Freebox admin under Authorized apps. Pick something you'll recognise later.
freebox.pressArrow: Go to your Freebox and press → on the LCD within 30 seconds
freebox.pairingTimeout: The Freebox LCD prompt expired before approval. Try again.
freebox.pairingDenied: The pairing was rejected on the Freebox.
freebox.pairingFailed: Could not reach the Freebox. Double-check the base URL.

kubernetes.name: Kubernetes
kubernetes.description: Connect a Kubernetes cluster to monitor workload replica health
kubernetes.inClusterHint: Uses the service-account token mounted in SolidPing's own pod. Only works when SolidPing runs inside the target cluster; no credentials are stored.
kubernetes.insecureHelp: Disables API-server certificate verification. Use only for clusters with a self-signed cert you cannot pin.
kubernetes.testHelp: Probe the cluster API to confirm the credentials work. Uses the saved settings.

hint.slack: Connect a Slack workspace via OAuth
hint.discord: Send to a Discord webhook URL
hint.webhook: Generic JSON webhook to any HTTP endpoint
hint.email: Send notifications to one or more email addresses
hint.googlechat: Post to a Google Chat space via incoming webhook
hint.mattermost: Post to a Mattermost channel via incoming webhook
hint.freebox: Monitor a Free Freebox (line quality, sync rate, network state)
hint.webpush: Receive alerts as browser notifications on your subscribed devices
hint.kubernetes: Monitor Kubernetes workload replica health (Deployments, ReplicaSets)
